thread:
Marina (Partnerships): FYI — AcmeEdge is asking to surface per-seat overrides in the marketplace usage webhook. They want to report seat_changes (add/remove) as part of their hourly usage so downstream billing can prorate mid-cycle. Could cause double-billing if we don't reconcile properly. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sam (Integrations Eng): Do we currently accept anything like seat_count or seat_delta in partner payloads? I think marketplace events just carry usage_units and sku_id today.

Nina (Billing): Right now ledger ingestion expects a stable entitlement per billing epoch. Mid-cycle seat adjustments are handled by separate adjustments feed, not the usage stream. Mixing them will break idempotency unless the webhook includes a deterministic entitlement_epoch or sequence. :exclamation:

Jordan (Partner Success): From AcmeEdge's side they want a single webhook so they don't run 2 flows. They suggested adding seat_delta and seat_snapshot to the same event. They can include an idempotency key per change.

Sam (Integrations Eng): If we accept seat_snapshot we can use that as the source of truth for entitlement reconciliation. But we need to be explicit about the semantics: is snapshot absolute seat_count at timestamp T? And do we accept negative seat_delta? Also need to decide whether usage_units continue to be metered the same way.

Nina (Billing): Proposal: require both seat_snapshot and entitlement_sequence fields. seat_snapshot = integer (absolute seats at event_ts), entitlement_sequence = monotonically increasing integer per customer. If we see a lower sequence we've already applied or will ignore. That lets us be idempotent and compute pro-rate deltas. We'll also store last_applied_sequence per customer.

Alex (SRE): Storage-wise fine. But careful: partner retries + out-of-order delivery. We already have a dedupe window keyed by event_id. The add of entitlement_sequence helps. Also we need to surface a replay endpoint for partners to backfill missed seat changes. Suggest a short-runbook for partner replays.

Marina (Partnerships): AcmeEdge also asked about tax/currency rounding when prorating mid-month — they want the invoice line to reflect exact cents per seat change. Does our billing pipeline support cents-level prorate adjustments per seat event?

Nina (Billing): We can emit adjustment line items in minor units (cents) if we compute prorate = (days_remaining / days_in_cycle) * monthly_price_per_seat, rounding rule = banker's rounding. But we need to decide whether to credit previous invoice or include on next invoice. Ops preference: create an adjustment item on the current open invoice if within invoice_window, else append to next invoice and surface as "pending credit".

Jordan (Partner Success): AcmeEdge wants credits applied immediately to reduce customer confusion. They will accept an initial implementation where we create an adjustment line on current invoice if invoice_status=open, otherwise send a notification and queue for next invoice.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Technical: we'll require the webhook schema to include a new top-level block. Example payload draft:```json
{
  "event_id": "evt-01F5...",
  "event_ts": "2026-03-20T12:34:56Z",
  "customer_id": "cust-123",
  "sku_id": "acme-seats-monthly",
  "usage_units": 1200,
  "seat_snapshot": 42,
  "entitlement_sequence": 17,
  "idempotency_key": "replay-20260320-17"
}
```
This keeps usage_units separate (token/units) and seat_snapshot for entitlement reconciliation. We'll also emit an "entitlement_applied" ack with last_applied_sequence on success.

Alex (SRE): We should rate-limit the seat change path since partners might spike when doing bulk seat migrations. Also enforce payload size limits. And add an observability metric: "partner.entitlement.sequence.skew" to catch missing sequences.

Nina (Billing): Action items for billing: (1) Add entitlement_sequence handling to ledger writer and compute prorate adjustments, (2) implement rounding policy doc (banker's rounding, cents), (3) decide invoice-window cutoff logic. I'll draft the RFC.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Action items for integrations: (1) Publish webhook schema v2 with seat_snapshot + entitlement_sequence + idempotency_key, (2) implement ack endpoint, (3) add replay endpoint + test harness. I'll open PRs.

Jordan (Partner Success): I'll coordinate with AcmeEdge PM — confirm they can emit entitlement_sequence and will run a replay if needed. I'll share the sample payload and the replay plan.

Marina (Partnerships): Nice. Can we aim to ship a partner beta by end of next sprint? AcmeEdge is on a tight go-live with a joint announcement. :calendar:

Nina (Billing): Beta timeline OK but we need the RFC this week. I'll tag legal for any language on refunds/credits policy.

Alex (SRE): I'll add dashboard tiles for sequence skew and processing latency. Also a small runbook for "out-of-order entitlement" situations.

billing-bot: Created ticket INV-3421 for "Entitlement sequence + prorate support" and linked to this thread. :white_check_mark:

Marina (Partnerships): Great — thanks all. I'll post an external-facing short doc for AcmeEdge once we have schema v2. :thumbsup:
